newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average jumped 76.03 points to 6,547.79. The market got a lift from a surge in the stock of Dow component Philip Morris, which rose in late trading on news that Food and Drug Administration Commissioner David Kessler, leader of the Clinton Administration's fight to regulate tobacco, will leave his post.
* Newly-listed Bank BNI made a spectacular debut on the Jakarta Stock Exchange on Monday, closing at 1,250 rupiah compared with an offer price of 850 rupiah.
* Indonesia will expedite the repayment of its foreign debt, particularly those with lending rates of above nine percent, Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said.

* The Jakarta Composite Index closed up 15.38 points, or 2.51 percent, at 628.24 points on Monday following the listing of Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) coupled with active buying of some blue-chip counters.
* Brokers said the market was likely to stay firm on Tuesday following sharp gains by newly-listed BNI on Monday.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,345.90/46.25 in early trading against the opening of 2,345.50/46.50.
* Newly-listed Bank BNI, following positive debut on Monday.
* Bank Ficorinvest on announcement of stock split to 500 rupiah per share from 1,000 rupiah.
* Property firm Putra Surya Perkasa on reports that its apartment complex in Jakarta had booked sales of 50 billion rupiah during the launch.
* Timber firm Barito Pacific on market talk of a possible takeover by a prominent business group, despite a company denial last Friday.
